summary: A mobile-friendly checklist app with neumorphic UI for store safety inspections. Users enter store name, complete predefined checklist items, capture photos, and generate PDF reports.
architectural_notes: No file uploads allowed - camera capture only
No Caffeine AI branding in footer
Neumorphic design system with soft shadows and subtle depth
Inline camera view (not popup) for photo capture per checklist item

existing_features.title: Create a store name input field that users can fill before starting the checklist
Implement a predefined checklist with exactly 7 items: Drive thru window, Back door, Front door, Upstairs door, Cash collected, OnlineHM App closed, Staff toilet
Add in-app camera integration that allows users to capture photos directly within the app for each checklist point, with no file upload functionality
Reset the checklist form after submission, clearing all inputs, checkboxes, and captured photos
Generate and allow download of a PDF report containing the store name, all checklist items with their statuses, captured photos, and submission timestamp
Implement neumorphic design system throughout the entire UI with soft shadows, subtle depth effects, and smooth surfaces
Remove Caffeine AI branding from the footer or any visible area of the application
Optimize the entire application for mobile browser usage with responsive layout, touch-friendly controls, and appropriate viewport settings
Add a small attach image button next to each of the 7 checklist items (Drive thru window, Back door, Front door, Upstairs door, Cash collected, OnlineHM App closed, Staff toilet)
When user clicks the attach image button, display an inline camera interface within the screen (not as a popup or modal) that allows photo capture
Allow users to associate the captured photo with the specific checklist item that triggered the camera
Update the PDF generation to include all captured photos, showing each photo next to its corresponding checklist item
Update form reset functionality to clear all per-item photos when the form is reset after submission

new_feature_requests.summary: Predefined checklist with 7 items (Drive thru window, Back door, Front door, Upstairs door, Cash collected, OnlineHM App closed, Staff toilet)
